newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel flat in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel flat in dull trade.

text.p: The Israeli shekel traded almost unchanged against the dollar and the basket of key foreign currencies in dull trading on Monday, dealers said.
The Bank of Israel did not set a representative rate because of the U.S. Memorial Day.
"Volume was low today and the market was quiet. Many investors were not active as they could not make transactions to the U.S. because of the Memorial Day weekend," said Gideon Sadeh at Bank Leumi.
"The market is waiting for the central bank's interest rate decision but we expect a cut of only 0.4 percentage point or less and this will have no real impact on trading."
The Bank of Israel will announce its key lending rate for June later on Monday.
In late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.3975 shekels against 3.3980 on Friday. The basket was traded at 3.7060 shekels against 3.7041 on Friday.
